title: Exports-aware npm package cost explorer (install size + per-entry bundle size), fully client-side
user: Frontend/Node developer choosing between dependencies who wants reliable install size, tree-shaken bundle size per subpath export, and dependency-tree bloat for a package@version, without a rate-limited, decaying service.
smallest_useful_product: A static site that accepts package@version, reads npm registry metadata and package tarballs in the browser, resolves exports/main/module, estimates install footprint and transitive dependency count, bundles selected entry points with esbuild-wasm, displays minified and gzip sizes, shows version history, and creates a shareable URL.
constraints: Fully client-side. Package downloads are capped at 50 MB. Browser analysis cannot bundle native/optional dependencies and must identify Node-only packages. CSS and asset accounting, local uploads, Deno/JSR, and side-effect analysis are not in v1.
